email.subject: Marigold Health: an update on your application
email.body:
Hi,

We've reviewed your application for the Product Manager role at Marigold Health, and unfortunately we won't be moving forward with it.

Our data team, however, is hiring a Data Product Analyst, and the hiring manager would like to interview you for that role. Please pick a 45-minute slot for the interview here: https://calendar.marigold.example.com/book/dpa

Best wishes,
Grace Lin
Recruiter, Marigold Health
